tonight.headline: Jacobs is still in your lineup — move Gordon in
body: Bad news first: Josh Jacobs needs finger surgery and is out 1-3 weeks — and he is still in your RB slot at 0.0. Bloodsports lost Week 9 by 14.96 and are 2-7.
Week 10 is against Maye-day, 55% as set. Starting Gordon for Jacobs is the whole 16.0-point gap to the projection lineup. Daniels and Likely play Thursday night.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Mahomes' elbow (day-to-day, MRI clean) is the unpriced item: Rice is your WR2 and there is no healthy receiver behind him.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Mahomes ruled out by Friday — then Rice's projection is wrong and there is still no swap.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Jacobs' game locks Sun 12:00 CDMX — do it today
doFirst.title: Bench Jacobs, start Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: Jacobs is out after finger surgery and still sits in your RB slot — a 16.0-point hole.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Fractured finger in Week 9; surgery this week, out 1-3 weeks, IR not ruled out (Packers.com 9 Nov; LaFleur via NBC 9 Nov). ESPN has him OUT at 0.0.

case.label: The replacement
case.body: Ollie Gordon II, 16.0 at Indianapolis — 94% of Miami's carries in Week 9 (archive). He moves from FLEX to RB only in the sense that the lineup check wants him in either; Marks (13.9) stays on the bench by projection.

case.label: Not a drop
case.body: Green Bay's bye is Week 11; Jacobs can be back by Week 12. His open thesis says never a drop.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jacobs is active in Week 10 (archive shows a Week 10 line for him).

whatWentWrong.title: Jacobs' first-quarter injury, and 8.9 points on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Lost 106.96 to 121.92. Jacobs scored 0.5 before breaking a finger; Tuten, Loveland and Marks left 8.9 on the bench.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Jacobs 0.5 (injury exit, not graded); Taylor 9.4 on 19.6; Golden 32.4 kept it close (archive). The best lineup available would have scored 115.9 — still a loss by 6.0.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Jacobs is still in the RB slot for Week 10. The Do-first card fixes it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing — an injury exit is not a lineup call. It becomes one only if Jacobs is still in the lineup at kickoff Sunday.

case.body: On waivers until 02:00 Wednesday. A claim spends IPADE priority that never resets (you are 5th). If nobody claims him, he is a free agent Wednesday morning and costs nothing.
